summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $4.25/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $4.25 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 27, 2026, according to GasBuddy. AAA figures put the statewide average 12¢ lower than a week ago, 44¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.48 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Madison ($4.09) and the highest in Marshfield ($4.39).
